open_points.subject: _authorize_photo_reference
open_points.text: _authorize_photo_reference: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the photo only through get_progress_photo of the progress_photos repository PortalTransaction.progress_photos returns with photo_id, and close that read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback immediately after the read, marking it closed before it evaluates project scope or client visibility and before it raises PhotoValidationError; leaving the transaction open on any path, committing it, and using a legacy transaction-level photo method are forbidden.

open_points.subject: list_progress_photos
open_points.text: list_progress_photos: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read only through list_project_photos of the progress_photos repository PortalTransaction.progress_photos returns with the project_id of the context, and close that read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback immediately after the read, marking it closed before it filters viewer visibility or orders the result; visibility filtering and ordering belong to this function, not to persistence, and it MUST NOT use a legacy transaction-level photo method.

open_points.subject: publish_progress_photo replay
open_points.text: publish_progress_photo: [RETURN_SHAPE] When a photo already exists for the intake_id of the publication, MUST roll that read transaction back once through PortalTransaction.rollback and mark it closed before it compares replay content, then return the PhotoMutationResult the imported build_photo_mutation_result builds from the matching existing ProgressPhoto with replayed true, never the ProgressPhoto itself; a cross-project match or any content disagreement MUST raise PhotoConflictError. Neither replay path may insert a row, update a row, or append an audit.

set_aside.subject: ProgressPhoto record construction
set_aside.text: Never assign to an attribute of a model value (models are frozen): derive a changed value with value.model_copy(update={...}) or construct a new instance.
set_aside.other_text:
Constructing such a record here — its constructor, model_construct, model_validate,
or model_copy of a parameter of that type — is rejected (record_construction_bypassed).
- AuditIntent: build_project_audit_intent
- AuthorizedBinaryReference: build_photo_binary_reference
- PhotoMutationResult: build_photo_mutation_result
- ProgressPhoto: build_progress_photo, revise_progress_photo
- ProgressPhotoView: build_progress_photo_view
set_aside.question: Must changed ProgressPhoto values be produced through revise_progress_photo, or must model_copy/direct construction be permitted? The general instruction must exempt records governed by record_construction_backend.
